content.text:
Talking to myself as I go:

- Screen 1: Black background, light letters. Hard on my eyes even enlarged.
- "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". The first button is already lit up: "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים 182". So that's my task. 182 tracks!
- "דמי ניהול מ־0.15% עד 2%". Fees I understand, that's the bank's cut.
- Yellow box: "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026". Is that a problem? I don't know.
- Then a long row of buttons: "עוקב מדד s&p 500", "מניות", "הלכה יהודית", "אג"ח ממשלתי"... S, and, P? Not for me.
- Screen 2: A table full of numbers, coloured circles, "מניות" and "מט"ח" with percentages. 101%? How can it be more than a hundred? I skip the circles.
- I don't know which company the first rows belong to. The name was cut off between the screens.
- "גמל אג"ח ממשלתית". That I know, government bonds are safe. Fee "0.52% מההחיסכון". "4.9% 3 שנים", "2.69% 5 שנים". Why does five years give less than three? Did something fall?
- "גמל כספי (שקלי)": 4.37%, and 0% מניות. That sounds quiet too.
- Next to them the big ones, 22.07% and 28.61%. Those are shares. That's the gamble I remember from the adviser.
- Screens 3 and 4: More of the same. Company "מור", fees 0.62% to 0.68%. Lots of "פחות מ־5 שנים" and the same circles.
- Screen 5: "הפניקס", fees 0.15% to 2%. "גמל בניהול אישי" at 0.15%, but it says "כל חוסך מחליט במה להשקיע". Me decide alone? No.
- That's enough. My head hurts from all the numbers on black.

---

Hello, my dear. I didn't decide anything. I'll go over it with you, and maybe ask at the bank too.

The only things that looked like my kind of thing were "גמל אג"ח ממשלתית", because government bonds are safe, and "גמל כספי (שקלי)". Their fees are about half a percent. They gave around 4% for three years, but less for five, and I didn't understand why. The 0.15% fee was tempting, but in that track you choose the investments yourself, and that's not for me.

What I looked at, in order:
1. The top part: the title, the product buttons, the fee range and the yellow warning about the data.
2. The table, about four screens of it: one company whose name I never saw, then "מור", then "הפניקס".

What I skipped:
- The row of buttons with English letters and the other track types.
- The coloured circles.
- The "קופה" numbers in blue.
- The "כסף מנוהל" column.
- Everything after the fifth screen. I didn't see the other companies.

What I didn't understand:
- "S&P", "עוקב מדד", "מט"ח", "חשיפה".
- "מניות 101%" and "אג"ח 103%". More than a hundred percent?
- "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת לפני דמי ניהול". Is 4.9% for each year, or for all three together?
- Why the five-year figure is lower than the three-year one.
- Fees "מההחיסכון" and "מההפקדות". Two kinds of fee?
- "עוד לא דווח".
- "כסף מנוהל, סוף ספטמבר 2026": what does this tell me?

What I couldn't read: the little grey question marks, the small grey tags under the names, and the grey line at the bottom of the first screen.

What bothered me:
- The black background.
- Every row has five or six numbers and coloured circles. I got worried on the second screen and stopped after the fifth.
- I didn't know who made this site. "מקור"? It's not a bank I know.

input.answer: I didn't choose anything. Only the government-bond track (גמל אג"ח ממשלתית, fee 0.52%) and the cash-like shekel track (גמל כספי) looked safe enough for me, and I'll go over them with my son or the bank before I do anything.
